name: [ NEW ] Zombie Hell
desc:
✨Grand Opening
Survive waves of zombies with friends
Unlock new weapons
Reach the highest day

⭐Tips
You can drop money for teammates
Unlocking houses reveals money, civilians, weapon boxes, and other things
You can find healing items from weapon boxes
Saving civilians increases the day counter

Inspired by Left 4 Dead 2, Rivals, Zombie Uprising
Zombie Hell is an arcade shooter, wave survival game that gets progressively difficult.
